name: Torres de Alcalá
hero_subtitle: Historic coastal watchtowers and trails with open views over Rif cliffs and the Mediterranean.

overview.title: Towers above the sea
overview.p1: Torres de Alcalá refers to the historic coastal watchtowers and the surrounding cliff paths on the park shoreline — a heritage and viewpoint stop rather than a swimming beach.
overview.p2: Walks here reward you with wide Mediterranean horizons and a sense of how this coast was watched and worked for centuries.
overview.p3: Wear proper shoes, avoid cliff edges in wind, and carry water. Pair with Cala Iris for a full park-coast outing.

food.title: Food near Torres de Alcalá
food.p1: Plan meals in Al Hoceima town or at seasonal beach cafés; pack water for park-coast outings.
food.li1: Grilled fish near the port and corniche.
food.li2: Simple cafés at Quemado and Sfiha in season.
food.li3: Carry water and snacks for Cala Iris, Torres and Bades.
food.li4: Hotel restaurants if you stay on the bay.
food.li5: Confirm opening hours outside peak summer.
food.p2: Cash helps at small beach and village stops.

q1.question: Is it a difficult walk?
q1.answer: Short sections are moderate; exposure and uneven ground matter more than distance.

q2.question: Good for children?
q2.answer: Older children with close supervision; not ideal for toddlers near cliffs.

q3.question: Best time?
q3.answer: Morning light and cooler air; avoid midday summer heat on exposed rock.

q4.question: Do I need a guide?
q4.answer: Not for main viewpoints; helpful if you want longer trail context.

q5.question: Combine with Bades?
q5.answer: Possible on a longer day with a driver who knows the coast road.

page.intro: Explore Torres Alcala, a captivating destination offering unforgettable landscapes, historical heritage, and rich cultural experiences in Morocco.

content.hero_subtitle: Discover the authentic charm and unique experiences of Torres Alcala.
content.sec1_text: Located in one of Morocco's most picturesque regions, Torres Alcala offers visitors an immersive journey into rich heritage, stunning architecture, and warm local hospitality.
content.sec2_text: Whether you are exploring historical sites, tasting traditional Moroccan flavors, or discovering surrounding natural landscapes, Torres Alcala provides memorable moments for every traveler.
content.sec3_text: To make the most of your visit to Torres Alcala, plan your itinerary during optimal seasons, connect with certified local guides, and experience authentic local accommodations.
